scope: Ordered current projection and source lifecycle
Full retained BRB/WHAM configuration composition at finite targets
verification.evidence_ceiling: Named geometry, lifecycle and configuration cases only; no arbitrary-input scientific correctness or release claim.
known_limitations: No experimental validation of source device constants, conductor area proxy or material magnetization is claimed.
Direct geometry/weight arrays can be mutated; cache content changes are detected, but mutation that desynchronizes parameterized geometry from its parameters is outside the supported contract.
Unknown **kwargs are permissive where inherited; no arbitrary keyword semantic claim.
Plotting/patch, simplify/clone, multiprocessing, electrodes and persistent sweeps are excluded or unresolved.
All scientific, human and release approvals remain false.

summary: Construct finite weighted circular-filament source points and evaluate their mesh-dependent fields.

identity.direction: source geometry and weights to mesh-dependent field responses
identity.definition: Finite (R,Z) points share one current scalar and carry dimensionless signed weights.
identity.model: Axisymmetric ideal circular filaments evaluated by the Green kernel.
identity.geometry: Finite cylindrical source points with mutable coordinates and weights.
identity.coordinates: R,Z in metres; current in amperes; weights dimensionless.
identity.boundary: A target coincident with an active positive-radius filament is singular.
assumptions: Source points are finite with nonnegative radius.
A mesh is required for field evaluation.
Geometry and weights are retained in caller order.

outputs.name: source
outputs.description: Constructed ArbitraryPoints object. Available properties/methods: psi: Flux response [Wb/rad], (Nt,); BR: Radial field response [T], (Nt,); BZ: Axial field response [T], (Nt,)
outputs.constraints: Field methods require a configured or supplied target mesh; geometry and lifecycle properties follow the source class.

preconditions: Source points are finite with nonnegative radius.
A mesh is required for field evaluation.
supported: Finite point sets, signed weights, mesh conversion, transforms, and cache invalidation.
excluded: Plotting, simplify, multiprocessing, and persistent sweeps.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError is raised for malformed or nonfinite points, currents, weights, meshes, or active-filament coincidences; unsupported simplify or device additions raise NotImplementedError.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError from a nonrepresentable Green response propagates; failed parameterized updates restore the previous valid geometry.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; construction and field evaluation are direct.
failure_semantics.partial_results: A failed constructor returns no object; atomic updates keep the previous valid state.

example.description: Construct one weighted source on a one-point mesh and verify the returned flux shape.
example.code:
from scirel.electromagnetism import ArbitraryPoints
s=ArbitraryPoints([[1.,0.]],mesh=[[.2,.3]])
assert s.psi().shape == (1,)
example.expected: The constructor succeeds and psi() returns one finite value with shape (1,).
